Harmony of Despair for PC, Linux/SteamOS, Mac, Android, iPhone and iPad.

None of the downloads include the game. On first launch each version asks for your own copy of the Xbox 360 game files (base game, Title Update 2 and any DLC you own).

## What's new
- DLC chapters 7–11 now unlock in order: each one opens once you've cleared the chapter before it, the same way Chapters 1–6 do.
- PC: a new **Harmony of Despair.exe** starts the game without a black command window. `Launch-Harmony.bat` still works.
- Android 0.43: the default player name is now "Player".
- Online play (invite codes, team search and Quick Search) works between every version, at home and over the internet, including mobile data.

## Downloads
| Device | File |
|---|---|
| Windows PC | `HarmonyRecomp-windows-amd64.zip` |
| Linux / SteamOS (Steam Deck, ROG Ally) | `HarmonyRecomp-linux-amd64.tar.gz` |
| Mac (Apple Silicon) | `HarmonyRecomp-macos-arm64.zip` |
| Android | `HarmonyRecomp-android-0.43.apk` |
| iPhone / iPad | `HarmonyRecomp-ios-unsigned.ipa` |

### Windows
Extract the zip to a normal folder and double-click **Harmony of Despair.exe**. The first time, Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Then pick the folder that holds your game files.

### Android
Open the APK on your phone or handheld and allow installing from this source if Android asks. Updating from an earlier release keeps your save.

### iPhone and iPad (sideload)
Needs iOS / iPadOS 17 or newer. A device with 8 GB of memory (recent Pro iPhones, M-series iPads) is recommended.
1. On a Mac or Windows PC, install **Sideloadly** (or AltStore).
2. Plug in your iPhone or iPad and unlock it.
3. Drag `HarmonyRecomp-ios-unsigned.ipa` into Sideloadly, sign in with your own Apple ID, and press Start.
4. On the device, open Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, tap your Apple ID and choose Trust.
5. If iOS asks, turn on Developer Mode (Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode) and restart.

On first launch, put your game files in the app's folder using the Files app, then follow the on-screen setup. With a free Apple ID the app stops opening after 7 days; re-install it with Sideloadly to renew (your saves are kept). Free Apple IDs allow at most 3 sideloaded apps per device.

## Icon
Want the emblem icon? Download it from SteamGridDB: https://www.steamgriddb.com/icon/20933
- On PC, save it as `Harmony.ico` in the game folder and the launcher window uses it. You can also set it as the icon of a desktop shortcut to **Harmony of Despair.exe**.
